intro: ClickFix, Lazarus Group, and UNC6692 were the most frequently observed threat actors across the 60 social-engineering incidents catalogued between April and August 2026. Coverage centered on CVE-2023-36036, CVE-2025-24054, CVE-2025-33053, and CVE-2026-21513, with attacks hitting financial services, cryptocurrency, technology, and government sectors. The reporting spanned Global, North America, Europe, the United States, and Australia, with 46 high-severity cases, 11 medium, 2 informational, and 1 critical. These campaigns relied on deceptive lures to compromise users, with Lazarus Group and UNC6692 each appearing as separate, distinct actors in the archive.
